title: Bar Drop Pink Grapefruit 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: Bar Drop Salts Pink Grapefruit by Drop captures the distinctively bittersweet profile of this citrus favourite. It delivers the sharp, zesty tang of fresh grapefruit on the inhale, underpinned by a subtle, ruby-sweet undertone. The result is a bold, palate-cleansing vape that is vibrant and full of character. Crafted with a 40% VG / 60% PG ratio, this e-liquid enhances the sharp citrus notes, delivering a more impactful taste than standard high-VG alternatives. Ideally paired with MTL (Mouth-to-Lung) pod kits, the nicotine salt formula ensures a smooth throat hit in 5mg, 10mg, or 20mg strengths, providing rapid satisfaction. Bar Drop Salts are brought to you by Drop and are manufactured right here in the UK. Drop’s collections focus on fabulously fruity flavours that are achingly authentic and blend familiar favourites with unique profiles.
